Creature Catch Field Guide

Every creature from Home Village to the Night Ruins: where to find them, how they grow, and the stories the old folks tell about them.

CreaturesTypesRegionsCubes & items

Creatures

Creatures hide in tall grass and jump out when you walk through it. Weaken one, throw a cube, and it's yours. Most grow into stronger forms as they level up, and a few need a shard to change.

Types

Eight elemental types go round in a wheel. Each one hits two others for double damage and is hit hard by two others. Normal sits outside the wheel and is even with everything. Read across from the attacking type, then down to the defender.

2 = double damage½ = half damageblank = normal damageA creature with two types multiplies both, so 4x and ¼x can happen.

Regions

The land is one long road from Home Village to the Night Ruins. Each region's wild creatures are a little stronger than the last, and a guide at each exit opens the way forward once you beat their trial. Every region has an outpost with a Healing Hut and the Cube Vault.

Cubes & items

Every capture cube is purple on top and blue on the bottom. Better cubes add bands and studs, and better odds. A creature that is worn down, asleep, or frozen is much easier to catch.

Creature Catch Field Guide, made from the game's own data (v7). Pictures marked "art coming" are still being painted.
